The present Criminal Writ Petition, filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, has been filed with the following prayer:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari to quash the impugned FIR No. 0132 of 2025, dated 22.08.2025 U/s 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Cantt, District Dehradun.

(ii) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing the respondent nos. 1 and 2 not to arrest the Petitioner in FIR No. 0132 of 2025, dated 22.08.2025 U/s 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Cantt, District Dehradun."

4. The Petitioner has also filed a Stay Application, seeking a stay on the arrest of the Petitioner,
pursuant to the FIR No. 0132 of 2025, dated 22.08.2025 U/s 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Cantt, District Dehradun.

Issue notice to Respondent No. 3.
7. Steps to be taken within a week.

8. Let the objections be filed by the Respondents.
9.
